method: Actual in-app browser controls, visible status and screenshots

checks.name: Importing a v10 ship with a pending automatic route retains position 20,20 and 2 oil without showing a future destination
Single-ship and group panels have no cancel-route controls; turn panel has no automatic-movement count
Unaffordable single move to 24,20 reports need 5 oil, leaves position 20,20 and oil 2 unchanged, and shows no future path
Box selection includes Laffey and Bismarck; group move to 22,22 reports need 4 oil and leaves both ships and oil 2 unchanged
Laffey moves one hex to 21,20, oil decreases 2 to 1, combat action remains 1
Browser refresh restores position 21,20 and remaining oil 1 with no automatic route
Two end-turn commands return to the player in round 2, refill oil to 50 and leave Laffey at 21,20
Original 256-by-256 four-faction round-1 battle restored: 50 oil, 12 live friendly ships, Laffey at 26,30 and no airborne squadrons

limits: Aircraft retain their existing real-time commands and mandatory return behavior.
Large-scale AI and complete-match performance remain outside this check.
